CARTO and Stadia are optional MapLibre vector styles. Use ?renderer=webgl to enable them; attribution remains visible in the map.
PMTiles archive
A same-origin .pmtiles path removes the third-party basemap dependency entirely. Build one with tools/build_basemap_pmtiles.py; cross-origin archives are blocked by this app's Content-Security-Policy.

Named Watchlists (X2)

Data Sources (Phase 16)
Data Relay
No public ADS-B feed sends CORS headers, so every request goes through a relay. The free public relays are unreliable: deploy workers/cors-relay.js to Cloudflare Workers (100,000 requests/day free) and paste its URL here. The host must also be added to connect-src in index.html and _headers before the browser will allow it.

Receiver Coverage (X13)
Enter a tar1090/readsb base URL. VIPTrack reads receiver.json, aircraft.json, and stats.json directly; your feeder must allow browser CORS. No feeder data is sent to a proxy. A page served over HTTPS cannot reach an http:// feeder, and the feeder host must appear in this deployment's connect-src allowlist (index.html and _headers).
No receiver coverage loaded
OpenSky Historical Replay (X20)
Manual historical track lookup only; this never participates in the live refresh loop. Supply an OpenSky OAuth2 API client. Credentials stay in this tab and the secret is sent only to OpenSky’s token endpoint.
No historical track loaded
Historical Query Workspace
Source-independent local analysis. Import only archives you are permitted to use and declare their license/terms. Aircraft observations stay local, PIA identities are redacted, and no bulk archive is fetched automatically.

Coverage history
Coverage is built only from what this browser has observed. Nothing is fetched or transmitted, and privacy-protected aircraft are excluded when sampled and again when drawn. Retention follows the trail retention setting.
Heading lookahead
FAA Special-Use Airspace (X23)
Manual, opt-in FAA NASR/ADDS polygons for restricted, prohibited, MOA, and warning areas. The source is refreshed on a 28-day cycle; expired cached data is never shown. Informational only — not for navigation or operational decisions.
Show FAA SUA polygons
FAA SUA off · manual 28-day refresh
API credentials
Keys are stored in this browser only. They are never sent anywhere except the service they belong to, and are excluded from local-state backups and the diagnostics export.
OpenAIP Airspace (L6)
Opt-in Class A–G airspace tiles from OpenAIP. Your API key stays in this browser and is sent only to OpenAIP tile requests. Informational only — not for navigation or operational decisions.
Show Class A–G
OpenAIP off · API key required
Geofences (X5)
Name an area, then click Draw circle or Draw polygon. Circle uses two clicks; polygon uses three or more clicks followed by Finish.

Overlays (X10)
Remote overlays require an explicit Load click and public HTTPS. The host must also appear in this deployment's connect-src allowlist (index.html and _headers); local files have no such requirement.
Remote overlays require an explicit Load click and public HTTPS
Plugin / Overlay Catalog (L7)
Manifest-backed optional overlays and plugins. Every entry declares its version, license, data classes, capabilities, and cleanup hook; JavaScript modules are same-origin, disabled by default, and require an explicit Load click.
